title: Boss part 1: clean the lines

ticket.subject: Weekly word report (boss)
ticket.body: Clean the lines, count the words, rank the top words, and format the report. Each part is graded on its own.

rules: Remove spaces from both ends of each line.
Drop lines that are blank after trimming.
Keep the lines in their original order.

title: Boss part 2: count the words

ticket.subject: Weekly word report (boss)
ticket.body: Clean the lines, count the words, rank the top words, and format the report. Each part is graded on its own.

rules: Words are separated by any whitespace.
Return a dict from each word to its count.

title: Boss part 3: rank the top words

ticket.subject: Weekly word report (boss)
ticket.body: Clean the lines, count the words, rank the top words, and format the report. Each part is graded on its own.

rules: Ties are ordered A to Z.
Return at most n (word, count) pairs.

title: Boss part 4: format the report

ticket.subject: Weekly word report (boss)
ticket.body: Clean the lines, count the words, rank the top words, and format the report. Each part is graded on its own.

rules: Keep the order of the pairs.
